PairwiseSegmentScore.description:
Represents a score between two segments in a business context.

Bounds follow the BMG document's NetScore formula: synergy 0..+5,
conflict -7..0. Thresholds for branch/pattern decisions (e.g.
Multi-Sided at net_score >= +3) are calibrated against this range;
widening it invalidates those thresholds.

conflict.description: A score representing the conflict between the two segments, on a scale from -7 to 0.
conflict.title: Conflict

segment_pair.description: The pair of segments being scored.

synergy.description: A score representing the synergy between the two segments, on a scale from 0 to 5.
synergy.title: Synergy

SegmentRelationType.description:
An enumeration of the different types of segment relations.

The book's Customer Segments building block (pp. 20-21) describes
five segment types: Mass market, Niche market, Segmented,
Diversified, and Multi-sided platforms. Only the last three
describe a relationship BETWEEN two or more distinct segments;
Mass market and Niche market describe a single-segment model and
therefore have no "relation" to classify. Since this enum exists
specifically to tag how multiple segments relate to each other
within one canvas group, only those three carry over here.
